nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 tracking authorized accounts (access control whitelist) in CoinJoin.
SAFEEngineLike public state variable; external SAFE engine contract holding internal coin balances.
DSTokenLike public state variable; external ERC-20 representation of the system coin (mint/burn).
uint256 flag (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled) guarding the exit function.
uint256 number of decimals of the system coin, set to 18 in the constructor.
Constant RAY = 10**27 used to convert wad (18 decimals) into rad (45 decimals).
external isAuthorized function granting auth by setting authorizedAccounts[account] = 1.
external isAuthorized function revoking auth by setting authorizedAccounts[account] = 0.
Modifier requiring authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] == 1 before executing the guarded function.
Constructor: authorizes msg.sender, sets contractEnabled = 1, wires safeEngine/systemCoin and decimals = 18.
external isAuthorized function setting contractEnabled = 0 to permanently disable exit.
internal pure multiply helper with strict overflow check (require(y == 0 || (z = x*y)/y == x)).
external function joining wad coins: moves RAY*wad internal coins to account and burns external wad from msg.sender.
external function exiting wad coins: requires contractEnabled == 1, pulls RAY*wad internal coins from msg.sender and mints wad to account.
msg.sender used as the key in the isAuthorized modifier access-control check.
msg.sender as untrusted external caller used for token burn, internal coin source and initial authorization.
State write authorizedAccounts[account] = 1 granting privileged access.
State write authorizedAccounts[account] = 0 revoking privileged access.
State write contractEnabled = 0 disabling the contract.
Arithmetic multiplication z = x * y with a require-based overflow guard.
External call systemCoin.burn(msg.sender, wad) destroying user tokens after internal transfer.
External call systemCoin.mint(account, wad) minting tokens after internal coin transfer.
External call safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(address(this), account, RAY*wad) inside join.
External call safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(msg.sender, address(this), RAY*wad) inside exit.
Constructor state initialization: authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] = 1 and contractEnabled = 1.
address account parameter of addAuthorization.
address account parameter of removeAuthorization.
address safeEngine_ constructor parameter.
address systemCoin_ constructor parameter.
uint256 x parameter of multiply.
uint256 y parameter of multiply.
address account parameter of join (recipient of internal coins).
uint256 wad parameter of join (18-decimal external amount).
address account parameter of exit (recipient of minted coins).
uint256 wad parameter of exit (18-decimal internal amount).
uint256 z return variable of multiply holding the checked product x * y.

edges.reason: addAuthorization parameter account is written into authorizedAccounts[account] = 1, granting authorization.
removeAuthorization parameter account is written into authorizedAccounts[account] = 0, revoking authorization.
Constructor parameter safeEngine_ is stored into the safeEngine state variable.
Constructor parameter systemCoin_ is stored into the systemCoin state variable.
multiply operand x flows into the x * y multiplication.
multiply operand y flows into the x * y multiplication.
Result of the checked multiplication is assigned to local variable z.
join parameter account is passed as the recipient of safeEngine.transferInternalCoins.
join parameter wad is scaled by RAY via multiply and passed to transferInternalCoins.
join parameter wad is passed as the amount burned from msg.sender.
join parameter wad is the multiplicand in multiply(RAY, wad).
exit parameter account receives the minted wad amount.
exit parameter wad is the mint amount for account.
exit parameter wad is scaled by RAY via multiply and passed to transferInternalCoins.
exit parameter wad is the multiplicand in multiply(RAY, wad).
msg.sender is the account whose external coins are burned in systemCoin.burn.
msg.sender is the source address of internal coins in exit's transferInternalCoins.
msg.sender is written into authorizedAccounts in the constructor, becoming the first authorized account.
msg.sender indexes authorizedAccounts in the isAuthorized modifier require statement.
isAuthorized modifier gates execution of addAuthorization.
isAuthorized modifier gates execution of removeAuthorization.
isAuthorized modifier gates execution of disableContract.
addAuthorization body executes the authorizedAccounts[account] = 1 state write.
removeAuthorization body executes the authorizedAccounts[account] = 0 state write.
disableContract body executes contractEnabled = 0.
disableContract writes the contractEnabled state variable to 0.
contractEnabled is read by the require guard at the start of exit.
Constructor executes the initial authorization and contractEnabled = 1 state writes.
join calls the internal multiply helper.
exit calls the internal multiply helper.
multiply body executes the x * y multiplication with overflow require.
join first executes safeEngine.transferInternalCoins.
join then executes systemCoin.burn after the internal transfer.
exit first executes safeEngine.transferInternalCoins.
exit then executes systemCoin.mint after the internal transfer.
External call to safeEngine during join gives control to an untrusted contract before systemCoin.burn, allowing reentrant join state changes.
External call to systemCoin.burn hands control to a token whose hooks could reenter join/exit.
External call to safeEngine during exit gives control to an untrusted contract before systemCoin.mint, allowing reentrancy.
External call to systemCoin.mint hands control to a token that could reenter exit/join before state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter account is a non-core argument of addAuthorization and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter account is a non-core argument of removeAuthorization and is merged into its owning function node.
Constructor parameter safeEngine_ only feeds a state-variable assignment inside the constructor; merge into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter systemCoin_ only feeds a state-variable assignment inside the constructor; merge into the constructor node.
Parameter x is a non-core argument of multiply and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter y is a non-core argument of multiply and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter account is a non-core argument of join and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter wad is a non-core argument of join and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter account is a non-core argument of exit and is merged into its owning function node.
Parameter wad is a non-core argument of exit and is merged into its owning function node.
Local variable z is only the checked product returned by multiply and is merged into that function node.
